description: This file contains unit tests for the LoraUtils class, verifying various utility functions related to Lora gateway data processing, such as hex/base64 conversion, gateway validation, and string checks.

classes.name: LoraUtilsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying behaviors and validation of LoraUtils functions.

methods.name: convertFromHexToBase64
methods.description: Tests conversion of hexadecimal string to base64 string.

methods.name: convertFromBase64ToHex
methods.description: Tests conversion of base64 string to hexadecimal.

methods.name: convertToHexString
methods.description: Tests conversion of byte array to hexadecimal string.

methods.name: testOddHexInput
methods.description: Verifies that an exception is thrown for hex input with odd length.

methods.name: testInvalidHexInput
methods.description: Verifies that an exception is thrown for invalid hex characters.

methods.name: isValidLoraGatewayReturnsTrueForValidGateway
methods.description: Checks that a properly formatted gateway is valid.

methods.name: isValidLoraGatewayReturnsTrueForGatwayWithVendorProperties
methods.description: Checks that a gateway with vendor-specific properties is valid.

methods.name: isValidLoraGatewayReturnsFalseForInvalidLoraPort
methods.description: Checks that a gateway with non-numeric lora-port is invalid.

methods.name: isValidLoraGatewayReturnsFalseForTooLowLoraPort
methods.description: Checks that a gateway with a negative port is invalid.

methods.name: isValidLoraGatewayReturnsFalseForTooBigLoraPort
methods.description: Checks that a gateway with port above 65535 is invalid.

methods.name: isValidLoraGatewayReturnsFalseForMissingUrl
methods.description: Checks that a gateway missing URL configuration is invalid.

methods.name: isValidLoraGatewayReturnsFalseForMissingProvider
methods.description: Checks that a gateway missing provider info is invalid.

methods.name: isValidLoraGatewayReturnsFalseForMissingAuthId
methods.description: Checks that a gateway missing auth-id is invalid.

methods.name: isValidLoraGatewayReturnsFalseForMissingData
methods.description: Checks that a gateway missing data is invalid.

methods.name: isValidLoraGatewayReturnsFalseForMissingLoraConfig
methods.description: Checks for missing Lora-specific configuration within the gateway data.

methods.name: getValidGateway
methods.description: Helper method to construct a sample valid gateway JsonObject for testing.

methods.name: isBlankReturnsTrueForNull
methods.description: Verifies isBlank returns true when input is null.

methods.name: isBlankReturnsTrueForEmptyString
methods.description: Verifies isBlank returns true for empty string.

methods.name: isBlankReturnsTrueForWhitespace
methods.description: Verifies isBlank returns true for whitespace-only string.

methods.name: isBlankReturnsFalseForWord
methods.description: Verifies isBlank returns false for a non-empty, non-whitespace string.

methods.name: getNormalizedProviderUrlFromGatewayDevice
methods.description: Verifies that trailing slash is trimmed from URL in gateway device JSON.
